events.title: A · MAP · Book 1 outline + comps
events.notes: TRACK A, MAP. Reread 1 source section. Write a 1-paragraph chapter summary in your words. Read 1 comp for 30 min. File: Book-1/00-Book-1-Map. Locks Jan 17.

events.title: A · WRITE · Sample chapter 1
events.notes: TRACK A, WRITE. Forward only, no fixing. 1,000 words. Retell your source passages in your own words. Done Feb 28.

events.title: A · WRITE · Sample chapter 2
events.notes: TRACK A, step WRITE. Forward only. Target 1,000 words. Done Apr 11.

events.title: A · WRITE · Proposal pages
events.notes: TRACK A, WRITE. Apr 17 overview. Apr 24 about + audience. May 1 marketing + platform (real numbers). May 8 comps + chapter outline. Readers get it May 9.

events.title: A · EDIT · Proposal from reader notes
events.notes: TRACK A, step EDIT. Work through reader notes. You change the words; Claude may only point at problems.

events.title: A · WRITE · Book 1 next chapter
events.notes: TRACK A, step WRITE. Keep drafting so you're ahead if an agent asks for more. Target 1,000 words.

events.title: A · WRITE · Memoir: 1 Paradise scene
events.notes: TRACK A, step WRITE. It Came From Paradise. One scene, start to finish. Don't reread old chapters first.

events.title: A · MAP · Tighten outline + log comps
events.notes: TRACK A, step MAP. Reread Saturday's summary, tighten it, add the comp you read to the comps list.

events.title: A · REVISE · This week's chapter pages
events.notes: TRACK A, step REVISE. Reread Saturday (and Wednesday) pages. Restructure, add or cut scenes. You expand here; nobody else does.

events.title: AGENTS · RESEARCH · 6 agents
events.notes: Research 6 agents: recent psychology/horror deals, wishlist, how they take queries. Log in QueryTracker. 7 Sundays x 6 = 40+. Claude can help.

events.title: AGENTS · TRACK · Replies + next batch
events.notes: Log replies in QueryTracker. Send a requested proposal within 48 hours. Personalize the next batch.

events.title: A · REVISE · Book 1 pages
events.notes: TRACK A, step REVISE. Reread and rework the week's pages.

events.title: B · EDIT → SHIP · Next Tuesday's post
events.notes: TRACK B. EDIT: fill [SEAN] markers, cut what isn't you. VOICE CHECK: read aloud. SHIP: Blog on-deck + Substack for Tuesday. From Jan 3, record the read-aloud.

events.title: B · SEED + weekly review
events.notes: TRACK B, SEED: 1 idea note for the post 2 weeks out. Ask Claude to EXPAND last week's seed. Review: Book 1 words, memoir scene, next weekend's targets.

events.title: OPTIONAL · Wed write night (A or B)
events.notes: Only if you have it. Pick one: TRACK A WRITE (500 more Book 1 words) or TRACK B EDIT (get a post ahead). Skipping costs nothing.

events.title: DECIDE · Lock Book 1 + subscriber goal
events.notes: Confirm Book 1 is the burnout book from your originals. Write down a subscriber number for Dec 2027.

events.title: CHECKPOINT · 4 posts in the blog queue
events.notes: Open QUEUE.md in the Blog repo. 4 scheduled = ready to launch.

events.title: LAUNCH · Blog + Substack, first post 6am
events.notes: You Don't Matter. That's the Best News.

events.title: START · Read-aloud recordings
events.notes: From today, the Sunday Track B block includes recording next Tuesday's post.

events.title: DEADLINE · Book 1 outline + comps locked
events.notes: Track A. Chapter list with 1 paragraph each, plus 5 to 8 comps.

events.title: DECIDE · Which 2 sample chapters
events.notes: Suggestion: the opening, plus the It Really Doesn't Matter chapter.

events.title: DEADLINE · Sample chapter 1 done
events.notes: Revised and edited.

events.title: LAUNCH · Substack paid tier
events.notes: Audio extras + 21-Day Practice app as perks.

events.title: DEADLINE · Sample chapter 2 done
events.notes: Revised and edited.

events.title: SEND · Proposal to 2 or 3 readers
events.notes: Ask for notes by May 15.

events.title: DEADLINE · 40 agents listed + query final
events.notes: Query is 1 page: hook, the book, 2 comps, bio + platform, why this agent.

events.title: SEND · Queries batch 1 (10 agents)
events.notes: Personalized. Log each in QueryTracker.

events.title: DECIDE · Batch 1 results
events.notes: 0 requests: rewrite the query. Requests but passes: fix proposal or samples. Requests pending: keep going.

events.title: DECIDE · Batch 2 results
events.notes: Same rules as July 11.

events.title: DECIDE · Batch 3 results
events.notes: Same rules.

events.title: DECIDE · Offer or next round
events.notes: Offer: book the call, tell every agent still reading, give them 1 to 2 weeks. No offer: revise from the passes and list 20 more names.
